description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single attacks at Cap Break Level 1, grants ATK/MAG/MND +30%, Protect, Shell, Haste, 30% Stoneskin & Fire/Ice/Lightning Ability Damage +3% to party, grants Dual Awoken Clan Leader Mode I & 250 SB Points to user
Dual Awoken Clan Leader Mode I: Triplecast Black Magic/Dancer, Quick Black Magic/Dancer & chases 2 Black Magic/Dancer abilities with single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/NE Overflow magic attack, Weakness Damage +30% for 1 turn to party

description.name: Awoken Trinity Combo (Dual Shift)
description.text:
Grants [Instant ATB 1] & Dual Awoken Clan Leader Mode II to user
Dual Awoken Clan Leader Mode II: Instant Black Magic/Dancer & chases a Black Magic/Dancer ability with Single-target Prismatic Imperil & [Single-target DEF/RES/MND -50%] or [MAG/MND/DEF/RES +15% to party] with at least 0/4 Job Synergy members
